newsitem.title: UK: April Souedie price up five cents on March - trade.
newsitem.headline: April Souedie price up five cents on March - trade.

text.p: Contract lifters agreed on Wednesday with Syria's state oil company Sytrol on a five cent rise in the price of Syria's heavy Souedie crude for April lifting, traders said.
The lifters were heard to have agreed to dated Brent minus $4.70 a barrel for April loadings, up five cents from March.
Although Mediterranean crudes are well supplied, Souedie crude is extremely rich in bitumen and alternatives are hard to find, traders said.
